title: Frozen mocha coffee drink with non-dairy milk

content.title: About
content.content: Frozen mocha coffee drink is a refreshing frozen beverage made from cold coffee, chocolate syrup and non‑dairy milk (soy, almond or oat). It combines the rich flavor of coffee, a sweet mocha note and a creamy texture without any animal‑derived ingredients.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The drink is a staple of summer menus in cafés and food courts worldwide.
Non‑dairy milk makes it suitable for vegans and people with lactose intolerance.
Freezing coffee preserves most of the antioxidants found in fresh brew.
Chocolate syrup is often prepared from natural cocoa, giving a deeper flavor.
A pinch of sea salt is sometimes added to enhance the taste.

items.title: Caffeine boost
items.content: Caffeine improves alertness and can temporarily enhance physical performance.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Coffee and cocoa are rich in polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Lactose‑free
items.content: Using plant‑based milk eliminates lactose, benefiting those with intolerance.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Coffee provides vitamins B2, B3 and B5, supporting metabolism.

items.title: Calcium from fortified plant milk
items.content: Fortified non‑dairy milks can supply calcium and vitamin D.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: High caffeine intake may cause anxiety, insomnia and rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Chocolate syrup adds sugar; people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Allergy to plant ingredients
items.content: Some plant milks (soy, nut‑based) can trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Frozen drinks can be calorie‑rich due to sugar and cream, so consume in moderation.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the frozen mocha coffee drink in a glass with a straw, enjoying it right after thawing. Optionally top with whipped plant‑based cream, a dusting of cocoa powder, or grated chocolate.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen beverage at –18 °C in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks. Once thawed, consume within 24 hours.
